features.name: Page editor
features.summary: Lay out text, pictures and shapes on a page in the browser.

features.name: Publisher file import
features.summary: Open a Microsoft Publisher file and keep working on it.

features.name: Send for signature
features.summary: Send a finished document to TDPdf Sign, which emails each person a link to sign it.

features.name: Smart frames
features.summary: A text box that fills itself from a table of data: typed in, or loaded from a spreadsheet.

features.name: Our details
features.summary: Your organization's name, address, phone, email and website, typed once and inserted anywhere.

features.name: Make it fit
features.summary: Fits overflowing text to its box by tightening it slightly, without changing a word.

features.name: Parish templates
features.summary: Ready-made bulletin, flyer, sign-up sheet and newsletter that open with your parish's details filled in.

features.name: Share templates with your parish
features.summary: Sign in, start or join your parish with an invite link, and open the templates everyone in it shares.

features.name: Proofread
features.summary: Checks a text box for spelling, grammar and punctuation, and lets you apply each fix one at a time.
